profile.headline: Staff Engineer @ Intuit — AI Foundations · Eval platforms, agentic UI, and production reliability for GenAI products at scale
profile.summary:
Passionate coder and even more passionate gamer. I love to get lost in alternate realities.

“Conformity is the jailer of freedom and the enemy of growth.” -JFK

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built a portable, agent-agnostic evaluation library with a novel eval-governance doctrine gating CI releases on deterministic assertions, now the required certification gate path for a platform service and skill-bundle onboarding
- Co-led the skill-evaluation strategy for Expert Workspace end-to-end — from the evaluation foundation through onboarded eval pipelines to skill eval and LLM-judge/HEVAL calibration — driving a production routing-score improvement from 86 to 91 (+5.8%)
- Own the Agentic UI contract for Expert Workspace: designed and shipped the full path from agent-emitted UI to client rendering, including stable widget identity across re-emission, ICE-based delta publication, and a reference implementation proven end-to-end
- Contributed core platform capabilities to Intuit’s multi-tenant agent platform (Human-in-the-Loop interrupt/resume, skill-server migration, release-gated deployment pipeline) across four launches reaching 8,500+ experts with up to 360% AI-adoption growth and 89.1% first-try task success
- Own production incident-response readiness for Expert Workspace’s first production rollout — root-cause diagnosis tooling, observability hardening, and live on-call ownership of P1/P2 incidents
- Set engineering standards and accelerated the team: drove spec-driven-development adoption across the domain, built the AI-candidate interview rubric, and authored onboarding/teach-others guides adopted org-wide
positions.insights: Ai/LLM Evaluation, Agentic System and +11 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
GenAI Mission Team for Consumers & Experts
Overall, contributed significantly to the success of the team and Intuit by leveraging the latest in AI technology to solve real-world problems.
- Served as the Tech Lead for Expert Facing and Customer Facing Experiences, providing significant contributions to the success of the GenOrch and GenUX mission teams.
- Collaborated closely with AI specialists and Product Management/Customer Experience Design (PM/XD) teams in designing, developing, and deploying cutting-edge features that enhanced the user experience.
- Provided feedback and insights as a representative on plugin architecture, tested the Q&A model within our playground environment, and collaborated with DevX, Triton Web & Mobile teams in support of Gen UI framework.
- Assisted in designing and implementing an orchestration layer of communicating to GenAI Models as a POC and conversational flows as part of an integration with VoiceFlow.
- Contributed to designing and implementing prompt chaining in collaboration with partner engineers & PMs to provide a POC of TurboTax Full Service onboarding use case.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Virtual Expert Platform - Digital Assistant 
Overall, contributed significantly to the success of the QuickBooks & TurboTax digital assistant team by leveraging technical expertise and cross-functional collaboration to deliver innovative, user-centered solutions.
- Served as a key member in the migration for TurboTax Online Digital Assistant to a modern UI design, contributing to UI/UX changes for message bubbles, suggestion pills, avatar, and other redesign elements.
- Led the technical design for Alt Sourcing in TurboTax Online Digital Assistant, working closely with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration.
- Successfully migrated Conversation UI contact escalation to a Common Contact Us component, streamlining the process for users to reach out to customer support.
- Added new print functionality to the Digital Assistant UI for Alt Sourcing workflow, enhancing the overall user experience.
- Contributed to designing and implementing a new conversational workflow for third-party experts for consented vs. non-consented users, which involved presenting data to legal for review of the workflow.
- Led technical design efforts to expand the Next Intent model for QuickBooks Digital Assistant use case, making it more flexible and adaptable to changing user needs.

positions.title: Principal
positions.description:
Entrepreneurial business venture, founded on December 10, 2014, providing cellular and mobile repair services to consumers; specialized focus on Apple iOS and Samsung Android devices.
	Responsible for finance, marketing, tax, and day-to-day transactional operations of the business 
	Performed technical repairs on mobile devices.

projects.title: Empath (B2B SaaS sentiment Analysis for Employee Communication)
projects.description: Ruby on Rails web application with React.js front-end. Makes calls to the Gmail API, HPE Haven API and Watson Sentiment Analysis API on the backend to analyze email communication.

projects.title: LookieLoo (Yelp for NYC Public Toilets)
projects.description: Ruby on Rails web application that uses the Google Maps API data to present data from an NYC Open Data API. Users can search for public restrooms near them, "favorite" restrooms, and leave reviews. Admin users can review and delete users via an admin portal.
